Governance: regional reorganization to foster proximity

2026/05/27 - Company

Optimizing the delivery of our healthcare solutions to caregivers is one of our top priorities. To achieve this, our organization is now structured around three major regions. This agile model places our customers and industry evolutions at the heart of our decisions.

Read more

Seniors & Endocrinology: making chronic disease a stress-free Journey

2026/05/21 - Animal health

To address the challenge of pet aging, we have been accelerating our momentum in endocrinology across Europe since 2025. By progressively strengthening our portfolio, our teams are offering an increasingly comprehensive management approach for age-related pathologies. Our ambition: to transform chronic disease management into a seamless care journey, supported by the continuous expansion of our areas of expertise.

Read more

2026/05/05 - Animal health
